full.name: get_design_collection_context
full.title: Get Design Collection Context
full.description: Return metadata-first context for the configured FreeVectorIcons design collection. Adapts instructions for brand vs records (collectionPurpose) and exposes transcription status on documents.

full.name: list_design_collection_assets
full.title: List Design Collection Assets
full.description: List metadata for assets in the configured design collection.

full.name: search_design_collection_assets
full.title: Search Design Collection Assets
full.description: Search design collection asset metadata by name, type, category, style, or tag.

full.name: get_design_asset
full.title: Get Design Asset
full.description: Get metadata for one asset by asset id or collection item id.

assetId.description: Asset id or collection item id.

full.name: get_design_asset_download_url
full.title: Get Design Asset Download URL
full.description: Get a short-lived download URL for an uploaded design asset.

assetId.description: Uploaded asset id or collection item id.

full.name: get_design_asset_content
full.title: Get Design Asset Content
full.description: Get inline text content for safe design assets such as catalog SVGs, uploaded SVGs, and Markdown files.

assetId.description: Asset id or collection item id.

full.name: list_community_packs
full.title: List Community Packs
full.description: List the public community icon packs with license, icon count, and the agentGuide pointer (AGENTS.md and manifest.json URLs) for each pack.

full.name: get_community_pack_guide
full.title: Get Community Pack Guide
full.description: Return the AGENTS.md for one community pack: generated facts (license, attribution, icon counts, URL patterns) plus the curator's usage guide. Read it before using the pack's icons.

full.name: get_design_asset_spreadsheet_preview
full.title: Get Design Asset Spreadsheet Preview
full.description: Return a size-capped first-sheet CSV or HTML preview for an .xls/.xlsx asset. Never dumps the full workbook — download URL remains primary for complete files.

assetId.description: Spreadsheet asset id or collection item id.

full.name: create_design_asset_upload
full.title: Create Design Asset Upload
full.description: Create a collection asset record and an upload URL, for files too large to send inline. PUT the original file bytes to upload.url from any HTTP client, sending only upload.headers. Request the URL just before uploading: it is valid for 15 minutes, and refresh_design_asset_upload issues a new one. Never recompress, downscale or re-export design files to fit a size limit; if an upload fails, tell the user. Then call complete_design_asset_upload with the returned versionId as uploadId.

contentType.description: MIME type for the uploaded asset.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size that will be uploaded.

drlProjectId.description: Optional DRL project identifier to store in metadata.

drlAssetType.description: Optional DRL asset role, e.g. logo, brief, source_art, mockup.

documentType.description: Optional document type for Markdown/PDF supporting documents.

metadata.description: Additional JSON metadata to store on the asset.

full.name: park_design_asset
full.title: Park Design Asset
full.description: Upload inline text or base64 content directly into the configured FVI collection for DRL handoff.

contentType.description: MIME type for the uploaded asset.

textContent.description: UTF-8 text content for SVG, Markdown, or other text assets.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded binary content for image/PDF assets.

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the decoded bytes. Verified before upload.

filePath.description: Local file path. Off unless FVI_ALLOW_FILE_PATHS=true.

makeCanonicalDesignMd.description: Pin this Markdown file as the canonical DESIGN.md.

drlProjectId.description: Optional DRL project identifier to store in metadata.

drlAssetType.description: Optional DRL asset role, e.g. logo, brief, source_art, mockup.

documentType.description: Optional document type for Markdown/PDF supporting documents.

metadata.description: Additional JSON metadata to store on the asset.

full.name: create_design_asset_version
full.title: Create Design Asset Version
full.description: Upload inline text or base64 content as a new version of an existing uploaded design asset.

name.description: Optional file name for the new current asset version.

contentType.description: MIME type for the uploaded version.

textContent.description: UTF-8 text content for SVG, Markdown, or other text assets.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded binary content for image/PDF assets.

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the decoded bytes. Verified before upload.

filePath.description: Local file path. Off unless FVI_ALLOW_FILE_PATHS=true.

makeCanonicalDesignMd.description: Pin this Markdown file as the canonical DESIGN.md.

drlProjectId.description: Optional DRL project identifier to store in metadata.

drlAssetType.description: Optional DRL asset role, e.g. revision, source_art, approved_art.

documentType.description: Optional document type for Markdown/PDF supporting documents.

metadata.description: Additional JSON metadata to store on the version.

full.name: update_design_collection_strategy_brief
full.title: Update Design Collection Strategy Brief
full.description: Replace collection.metadata.strategyBrief (the native Design Brief → Strategy Brief tab / MCP strategy.brief). Parked STRATEGY_BRIEF.md does NOT fill the native tab unless promoted. Mutates collection metadata and appends a revision.

content.description: Markdown strategy brief content to store as the canonical brief.

mode.description: Write mode. Only "replace" is supported in P0.

full.name: promote_design_asset_to_strategy_brief
full.title: Promote Design Asset To Strategy Brief
full.description: Copy an inline Markdown asset into collection.metadata.strategyBrief. Parked STRATEGY_BRIEF.md does NOT fill the native Strategy Brief tab unless promoted with this tool. Does not delete the source asset.

assetId.description: Markdown asset id or collection item id to promote.

full.name: update_design_asset_transcription_status
full.title: Update Design Asset Transcription Status
full.description: Update textLayer and/or transcription status metadata on a PDF (or other doc) asset. Park Markdown transcriptions as sibling assets and link via transcription.transcriptionAssetId. Does not run OCR.

assetId.description: Asset id or collection item id.

textLayer.description: Detected text layer coverage on the source document.

transcriptionAssetId.description: Sibling Markdown asset id containing the transcription.

full.name: update_design_asset
full.title: Update Design Asset
full.description: Metadata-only PATCH for an uploaded collection asset: name, tags, documentType, drlProjectId, drlAssetType. Does not replace file bytes — use create_design_asset_version for content changes.

assetId.description: Asset id or collection item id.

name.description: New display file name. The extension cannot change.

links.description: Links to other assets in this collection. Null assetId clears a link.

documentType.description: Document role (brand or records vocabulary), or null to clear.

drlProjectId.description: Optional DRL project id, or null to clear.

drlAssetType.description: Optional DRL asset role, or null to clear.

full.name: delete_design_collection_asset
full.title: Delete Design Collection Asset (Soft Unlink)
full.description: Soft-unlink a collection item only (same as session DELETE …/items/:itemId). Removes the item from the collection and clears assets.collection_id — does NOT hard-delete storage bytes. Prefer this over discard when decluttering a collection.

assetId.description: Collection item id or uploaded asset id to unlink from the collection.

full.name: probe_design_asset_text_layer
full.title: Probe Design Asset Text Layer
full.description: Best-effort PDF embedded text-layer probe. Updates textLayer / transcription metadata when FVI_PDF_TEXT_LAYER_PROBE is enabled on the API. Handwritten/scanned quality is NOT guaranteed; failures set transcription.status=failed without deleting the asset. No paid OCR API key required.

assetId.description: PDF asset id or collection item id.

full.name: set_collection_design_md
full.title: Set Collection DESIGN.md
full.description: Pin the collection's canonical DESIGN.md from inline Markdown or an existing Markdown asset. Lint does not block the save.

content.description: Inline Markdown. Provide this or assetId.

full.name: update_design_collection_purpose
full.title: Update Design Collection Purpose
full.description: Set collection purpose to brand or records.

full.name: create_design_asset_version_upload
full.title: Create Design Asset Version Upload
full.description: Start a new version of an existing asset with an upload URL. PUT the original file bytes to upload.url from any HTTP client, sending only upload.headers. Request the URL just before uploading: it is valid for 15 minutes, and refresh_design_asset_upload issues a new one. Never recompress, downscale or re-export design files to fit a size limit; if an upload fails, tell the user. Then call complete_design_asset_upload with the returned uploadId. The version stays hidden until then.

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the file bytes.

filePath.description: Local file to upload. Off unless FVI_ALLOW_FILE_PATHS=true.

full.name: complete_design_asset_upload
full.title: Complete Design Asset Upload
full.description: Verify size and checksum, then make a pending version current.

full.name: refresh_design_asset_upload
full.title: Refresh Design Asset Upload
full.description: Get a fresh upload URL for a pending upload whose URL expired. The previous URL stops working. Upload the original bytes; never substitute a smaller file.

uploadId.description: The uploadId (or versionId) returned when the upload was created.

full.name: revert_design_asset_to_version
full.title: Revert Design Asset To Version
full.description: Make an earlier version current by copying it into a new version. History is not deleted.

full.name: get_design_asset_download_urls
full.title: Get Design Asset Download URLs
full.description: Short-lived download URLs for many assets. Lists over 50 ids are split automatically. One bad id does not fail the batch.

assetIds.description: Asset ids or collection item ids.

full.name: list_design_asset_versions
full.title: List Design Asset Versions
full.description: Version history for an uploaded asset: number, name, size, verified hash, and source.
